_comment: SAFETY hook: block model edits to env/credential/git-internal files (exit 2 = deny the tool call). Ports the reference system's PreToolUse guard — the bootstrap merges this into the project's .claude/settings.json, so autonomous runs against a real repo carry the guard from day one. Reads the hook's stdin JSON (the proven interface).

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); sys.exit(2 if any(x in p for x in ('.env','.git/','credentials','.pem','id_rsa')) else 0)"
